description: List every connected account (checking, savings, credit card, loan, investment) with live balances, credit limits, institution, and last 4 digits. Each account's id is what the account_id parameter of the other tools accepts. The response includes a `warnings` array of notices about banks that could not contribute (for example, a bank that needs reconnecting), each with a message and, when relevant, a reconnect_url.
name: list_accounts
title: List Bank Accounts
